title: Cellular Architecture with Zero Blast-Radius for Planetary Financial Settlement
subtitle: Cell-Based Partitioning (100 Cells), Blast-Radius Containment and Poison-Pill Isolation
problem_statement: A global core-banking settlement engine handles $4.5 trillion daily across 100 million accounts. An unhandled numeric overflow poison-pill transaction propagates through global shared queues, crashing downstream ledger services simultaneously across all 3 cloud regions. The system must be re-architected into 100 autonomous cellular units with zero shared-state and maximum 1% blast radius.

faded_bug.description: Cross-cell transaction coordination via shared central database breaches cellular blast-radius isolation.

studio_1_runtime.correct_fix_diff:
+ // Implement Two-Phase Transfer Protocol between isolated Cell Routers with zero global DB dependency
+ public void transferCrossCell(CellTx tx) { cellA.debit(tx); cellB.credit(tx); }

invariants.description: Failure of any single cell must never affect more than 1% of total system availability.

probing_ladder.stage_1_validation: Explain the architectural principles of Cell-Based Architecture as implemented by AWS and Stripe. What constitutes a strict cellular boundary?
probing_ladder.stage_2_tightening: How does a cross-cell transaction (Account in Cell 12 transfers money to Account in Cell 88) execute without a global coordinator that re-introduces a single point of failure?
probing_ladder.stage_3_adversarial: A poisoned payload triggers a fatal JVM crash in Cell 12. How does the Cell Router instantly isolate Cell 12 while keeping the other 99 cells at 100% operational throughput?
probing_ladder.stage_4_squeeze: Running 100 distinct database clusters multiplies base infrastructure idle cost by 5x. How do you consolidate storage hardware without compromising failure domain isolation?

counter_probes.counter_question: If your cell architecture relies on a central global coordinator for cross-cell transactions, what is the blast radius when that central coordinator fails?
counter_probes.expected_staff_answer: 100% blast radius. A true cellular architecture uses peer-to-peer 2-phase transfers with outbox pattern and escrow accounts between cells, eliminating any central coordinator.
